name: A Grand Time in Grand Junction 2026

venue.name: Redlands Community Center
venue.details: Meeting Room on Bottom Floor of Community Center

information:
Welcome back for another Grand Valley Competition!!

All competitors must read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering.
 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png)

**On-the-spot registration is NOT enabled** for this competition! If you would like to compete, please register before October 10th, and before our registration cap has been filled to insure your spot.

Live results, group assignments, and a more in-depth schedule can be found on the [Important Links](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GrandJunction2026#76742-important-links) tab.

We will be utilizing **Dual Rounds for 3x3** at this competition. See the [Dual Rounds](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GrandJunction2026#76920-dual-rounds) tab for more information.
